name: macOS Core Foundation user default text encoding

files.help:
Not applicable. Probably not remvoable.

From [Apple](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/technotes/tn2228/_index.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/DTS40007991-CH1-SUBSECTION15):

>Core Foundation tries to access the user's home directory to determine their default text encoding (stored in the file ~/.CFUserTextEncoding).
